entries.name: Eesti Maaülikool Väikeloomakliinik (Small Animal Clinic, Estonian University of Life Sciences)
entries.duty: Emergency care 24/7. Phone 09:00-20:00 +372 731 3224, night 20:00-09:00 +372 503 3878 (on-duty vet). Call before coming; critical patients are seen first and you may be referred elsewhere if the clinic is full.

duty_i18n.hr: Hitna pomoć 24/7. Telefon 09:00–20:00 +372 731 3224, noću 20:00–09:00 +372 503 3878 (dežurni veterinar). Nazovi unaprijed; najteži slučajevi imaju prednost, a ako je klinika puna, mogu te uputiti drugamo.
duty_i18n.de: Notdienst rund um die Uhr. Telefon 09.00–20.00 Uhr +372 731 3224, nachts 20.00–09.00 Uhr +372 503 3878 (diensthabender Tierarzt). Bitte vor dem Besuch anrufen; kritische Patienten werden zuerst behandelt, bei voller Klinik kann an eine andere Klinik verwiesen werden.

entries.note: Emergency-care page confirms 24/7 and both phones and address.

entries.name: PetCity Loomakliinik Rannamõisa (PetCity lemmikute kiirabi)
entries.duty: Pet emergency clinic, open 24 hours every day including public holidays, with a vet and assistant on site. Phone +372 602 0888 or short number 15222. Call ahead because doors are locked after regular hours; a 50% surcharge applies to out-of-hours emergency visits.

duty_i18n.hr: Hitna klinika za ljubimce, otvorena 24 sata svaki dan, uključujući blagdane, s veterinarom i asistentom u klinici. Telefon +372 602 0888 ili kratki broj 15222. Nazovi unaprijed jer su vrata nakon redovnog radnog vremena zaključana; za hitne posjete izvan radnog vremena naplaćuje se doplatak od 50 %.
duty_i18n.de: Notfallklinik für Haustiere, täglich 24 Stunden geöffnet, auch an Feiertagen, mit Tierarzt und Assistenz vor Ort. Telefon +372 602 0888 oder Kurznummer 15222. Bitte vorher anrufen, da die Türen nach den regulären Zeiten verschlossen sind; für Notfallbesuche außerhalb der Öffnungszeiten gilt ein Zuschlag von 50 %.

entries.note: Own petcity.ee page opened 2026-11-05: 'E-P 24H avatud'; 'võtame vastu loomi 24/7, ka riigipühadel'; 'on kohapeal ööpäevaringselt loomaarst koos assistendiga'; 602 0888, header 15222; surcharge 50% (windows 20-10 / 21-09 given).

notes: Estonia follow-up 2026-11-05. Own sites now reached via domain-restricted searches (evidensia.ee, petcity.ee). Verified 24 h: EMU Tartu small animal clinic, PetCity Rannamõisa (Tallinn), Loomade kiirabikliinik (Tallinn), Evidensia Tartu Väikeloomakliinik. Not reachable / skip, unreachable twice: PetCity Pärnu and Eedeni pages on petcity.ee, petcity blog on 15222, viljandiloomakliinik.ee (client/server error), hiiumaa.ee (robots), facebook.com Saaremaa Loomakliinik (robots), veterinaar.ee (robots), rus.vetdok.eu (robots), koer.ee Haapsalu/Kuressaare lists (aggregator, error), vastriku.ee, toometikliinik.ee, loomaarstid/koda sites not surfaced.
